notes: Frame-exact 30 fps: every render / normalized clip is now exactly N whole frames, with the audio cut or padded to exactly N/30 s. Clips from generators (24/25 fps, audio a few frames longer than the picture) used to leave a 0.1 s hole between joined parts and a black / frozen frame at the end. Length is taken from the picture, not the container. Body cache rebuilds once.
